criteria.statement: WorkerPolicyService.SelectWorker excludes workers whose SchedulingState is cordoned, draining, maintenance, disabled, or otherwise not active from new placements.
WorkerPolicyService.RankWorkers retains rejected workers with operator-visible reasons such as 'worker is cordoned' and 'worker is draining'.
MLPlacementService.SelectCandidate excludes workers whose SchedulingState is not active from new inference placements.
MLPlacementService preview candidate data includes rejected non-active workers and exposes scheduling rejection reasons for read-model/operator visibility.
